texts.introductionDescription:
Skill Breakdown
1. Forte Circuit
      ● Mirage: When Cantarella has at least 1 point of Forte Gauge [Trance], using an enhanced Heavy Attack will enter [Mirage] for 8 seconds. Exit [Mirage] when all [Trance] is consumed.
      ● [Trance]: Max cap is 5. Gained by landing the third hit of her Basic Attack, casting Intro Skill, enhanced Resonance Skill, or Resonance Liberation. While underwater, recovers 1 [Trance] every 5 seconds.
       In enhanced state, using enhanced Basic Attack, Mid-air Attack, or Dodge Counters consumes 1 [Trance] and grants 1 [Shiver] (max 3 stacks) while healing the team.
      ● Ultimate Resonance Skill [Perception Drain]: In enhanced stage, with 3 [Shiver], can consume all [Shiver] to cast ultimate Resonance Skill [Perception Drain] (Resonance Skill icon will glow, considered an Echo Skill). Counts as a Basic Attack. Deals Basic Attack DMG, applies [Hazy Dream] to enemies, and heals the entire team.
2. Resonance Liberation
      Also counts as Basic Attack DMG and Echo Skill. When on-field character deals DMG to a target, summon Dreamweavers to perform Coordinated Attack. Up to 1 Dreamweaver can be summoned each second, max 21 Dreamweavers in total. Resonance Liberation effect lasts for 30s or until reaching the max number of Dreamweavers.
3. Resonance Skill
      While in [Mirage], Cantarella can unleash an enhanced Resonance Skill, dealing DMG (considered an Echo Skill) and inflicting [Hazy Dream] on enemies.
      ● [Hazy Dream]: Slows the target for 6.5 seconds. If an enemy affected by [Hazy Dream] takes DMG, they trigger [Jolt] DMG (counts as Basic Attack DMG) and lose [Hazy Dream]. Attacks by other teammates will not [Jolt] a target influenced by [Hazy Dream] and will remove the [Hazy Dream].
4. Normal Attack
      ● Basic Attack: 3-hit combo. 
      ● Heavy Attack: Consumes STA to charge and deal DMG.
      ● Heavy Attack - Delusive Dive: When [Trance] is available, hold the Heavy Attack button to deal DMG and enter [Mirage].
      ● Mid-air Attack: Plunging Attack that consumes STA.
      ● Dodge Counter: Basic Attack DMG after a successful dodge.
5. Intro Skill
      Deals Havoc DMG and enables Basic Attacks to directly trigger the third hit for a short duration. While in [Mirage], triggers Coordinated Attacks 3 times.
      Paired with her Forte Circuit, using Intro Skill restores Concerto Energy when an ally performs an Echo Skill. Since most of Cantarella’s skills count as Echo Skills, she fully benefits from this effect, enabling rapid Concerto Energy regeneration.
6. Outro Skill
      Boosts the next character's Havoc DMG and Resonance Skill DMG.

My recommendation is to play how you want in the long run, as long as you are enjoying Cantarella and her playstyle. Wuthering Waves is all about having fun with your teams!

texts.introductionName: すぐわかるカンタレラの使い方
texts.introductionDescription:
■これだけやってればOKな戦闘ルーチン
①カンタレラの変奏スキル→専用ゲージ貯めてミラージュ状態→音骸→共鳴解放→この工程を変奏スキル発動から10秒以内に行う
②①の工程によって、モチ武器の「ふわふわの夢」が2スタックに到達→カンタレラに通常ダメ40%UP＆消滅耐性無視12%が付与（この効果はカンタレラが表にいるときのみ）
③ 五感ドレインを行う→専用ゲージ使い切るくらいまで戦ってカンタレラ終奏→他キャラへチェンジ
④再びカンタレラに戻る→①の工程に戻る

texts.introductionName: 一条攻略让你的【坎特蕾拉】成为湮灭主C
texts.introductionDescription: 坎特雷拉定位为五星湮灭副 C，同时具备治疗和增伤能力。她主要依赖普攻输出，战斗风格灵活多变。在水中时，其普攻、共鸣技能等命中目标能回复 “迷离”“颤栗”，还会召唤织梦水母协同攻击，提升输出效率。
